name: donggri-vscode
description: Native VS Code AI collaboration client for DonggriCompany

chatParticipants.name: donggri
chatParticipants.description: Review current code, bind workspace, and promote work to DonggriCompany tasks

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the current selection, file, or working diff

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Suggest or prepare an edit for the current selection or file

commands.name: task
commands.description: Promote the current context to a Donggri task

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a Donggri task from the bound project

commands.name: log
commands.description: Summarize the latest Donggri task log

commands.name: bind
commands.description: Bind the current workspace to a Donggri project

languageModelTools.name: donggri_read_active_editor
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the active file in VS Code with file path, language, selection, and file contents when available. Use this when you need exact local code context from the editor.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the active editor context from VS Code

includeFileText.description: When true, include the active file text in the result.

languageModelTools.name: donggri_read_selection
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the currently selected text in the active editor with exact file path and line range. Use this when the user is focused on a specific code region.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the current selection from VS Code

languageModelTools.name: donggri_read_working_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read git working diff for the active file or the workspace. Use this when you need pending changes and context that has not been committed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the current git working diff

languageModelTools.name: donggri_read_project_binding
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the current VS Code workspace to Donggri project binding including project id, path, and core goal. Use this before task promotion or execution control.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the current Donggri workspace binding

languageModelTools.name: donggri_create_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a Donggri task in the currently bound project from exact editor context. Use this only when the user explicitly wants to promote work to the company task system.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a Donggri task from the current context

runAfterCreate.description: When true, run the task immediately after creation.

languageModelTools.name: donggri_control_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run, pause, or resume an existing Donggri task by id. Use this only when the task id is already known.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run, pause, or resume a Donggri task

languageModelTools.name: donggri_read_task_terminal
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the latest terminal output and task logs for a Donggri task. Use this for progress checks, debugging, and concise execution summaries.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the latest Donggri task terminal output

lines.description: Maximum number of terminal lines to fetch.

donggri.apiToken.markdownDescription: Deprecated. Use the `Donggri: Set API Token` command to store the token in VS Code Secret Storage.

donggri.autoConnect.description: Automatically connect to DonggriCompany and start websocket sync when VS Code opens.

donggri.defaultProjectBindingMode.description: Workspace binding mode used by automatic Donggri project binding.
